verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk data export or account-exit feature. The only related item is that the REST API returns JSON, which is a developer building block a user could script into a self-built export, not a documented export capability, so it earns no credit. Data portability is a fair question for a CRM, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: This API uses a JSON format for output
